text.content:
Passages fork here into the Forsaken heart of the Charnel Halls, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: Something in the Crypts below is calling the recently dead home, one grave at a time.

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.
